messages.text: Hi, my reading lamp still hasn't arrived. Can you tell me where it is?

Your reading lamp (order d35-o1) has the status "shipped". The shop has no delivery time for it yet, so it hasn't been delivered. I can't see tracking details or a carrier location.

Refunds only apply to delivered orders (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). Cancelling the order or changing its delivery is outside this process. I can ask a staff member to help with that if you'd like.
